inputs.text: This is framed as a threat to “responsible citizens,” but the real question is whether gun design and sales rules can prevent harm and hold powerful manufacturers accountable. Unclear criminal penalties deserve scrutiny and clear limits; they shouldn’t be used to dismiss regulation altogether or make public safety solely about individual wrongdoing. Lawmakers should be transparent about who the rules apply to, while prioritizing the safety of communities most exposed to gun violence—not treating industry interests as more important than people’s lives.
